key: Your workouts are kept in your iCloud.
en: Your workouts are kept in your iCloud.
nl: Je trainingen worden in je iCloud bewaard.

key: Sign in to iCloud in Settings to sync with your iPad and Apple Watch. Your workouts are saved on this device.
en: Sign in to iCloud in Settings to sync with your iPad and Apple Watch. Your workouts are saved on this device.
nl: Log in bij iCloud in Instellingen om te synchroniseren met je iPad en Apple Watch. Je trainingen staan nu alleen op dit apparaat.

key: iCloud is blocked on this device (e.g. Screen Time).
en: iCloud is blocked on this device (e.g. Screen Time).
nl: iCloud is geblokkeerd op dit apparaat (bijv. Schermtijd).

key: iCloud is busy. Liftr tries again automatically; your workouts are safe on this device.
en: iCloud is busy. Liftr tries again automatically; your workouts are safe on this device.
nl: iCloud is even bezig. Liftr probeert het automatisch opnieuw; je trainingen staan veilig op dit apparaat.

key: Your workouts sync as soon as you're online again.
en: Your workouts sync as soon as you're online again.
nl: Je trainingen synchroniseren zodra je weer online bent.

key: Free up space in iCloud to keep syncing. Your workouts are safe on this device.
en: Free up space in iCloud to keep syncing. Your workouts are safe on this device.
nl: Maak ruimte vrij in iCloud om te blijven synchroniseren. Je trainingen staan veilig op dit apparaat.

key: This version of Liftr can't save to iCloud yet. Your workouts are safe on this device and sync once this is fixed.
en: This version of Liftr can't save to iCloud yet. Your workouts are safe on this device and sync once this is fixed.
nl: Deze versie van Liftr kan nog niet in iCloud opslaan. Je trainingen staan veilig op dit apparaat en synchroniseren zodra dit is opgelost.

key: Liftr tries again later. Your workouts are safe on this device.
en: Liftr tries again later. Your workouts are safe on this device.
nl: Liftr probeert het later opnieuw. Je trainingen staan veilig op dit apparaat.

key: iCloud could not be started. Restart Liftr to try again.
en: iCloud could not be started. Restart Liftr to try again.
nl: iCloud kon niet starten. Start Liftr opnieuw om het nog eens te proberen.
Houd je reeks van {1} weken vast.

key: Your workout is planned for today.
en: Your workout is planned for today.

nl: Je reeks van {1} weken loopt gevaar 🔥

key: A short workout today? Every rep counts.
en: A short workout today? Every rep counts.
nl: Vandaag een korte training? Elke herhaling telt.

key: This week: 1 workout, {1} lifted. Great job!
en: This week: 1 workout, {1} lifted. Great job!
nl: Deze week 1 training, {1} getild. Goed bezig!

key: This week: {1} workouts, {2} lifted. Great job!
en: This week: {1} workouts, {2} lifted. Great job!
nl: Deze week {1} trainingen, {2} getild. Goed bezig!

key: No workouts this week yet — next week is a fresh start.
en: No workouts this week yet — next week is a fresh start.
nl: Deze week nog niet getraind — volgende week is een nieuwe kans.

key: Point the camera at the code on your pass
en: Point the camera at the code on your pass
nl: Richt de camera op de code van je pas

key: Allow camera access in Settings, or choose a screenshot of your pass.
en: Allow camera access in Settings, or choose a screenshot of your pass.
nl: Geef toegang tot de camera in Instellingen, of kies een screenshot van je pas.

context: ScannerView.swift; ExercisePickerView.swift; GymPassViews.swift; ImportView.swift; LibraryView.swift; RoutineEditView.swift; SettingsView.swift; WorkoutSessionView.swift

key: Show the QR code or barcode at the entrance, right from Liftr.
en: Show the QR code or barcode at the entrance, right from Liftr.
nl: Toon de QR- of barcode bij de ingang, gewoon vanuit Liftr.

key: Tap the card to turn it over
en: Tap the card to turn it over
nl: Tik op de kaart om hem om te draaien

key: Tap the card to show the code
en: Tap the card to show the code
nl: Tik op de kaart om de code te tonen

key: Scan the card or key fob, or take a screenshot of the code in your gym's app and choose it here.
en: Scan the card or key fob, or take a screenshot of the code in your gym's app and choose it here.
nl: Scan je pasje of sleutelhanger, of maak een screenshot van de code in de app van je sportschool en kies hem hier.

key: Liftr couldn't find a QR code or barcode in this picture.
en: Liftr couldn't find a QR code or barcode in this picture.
nl: Liftr vond geen QR- of barcode in deze afbeelding.

key: Start an empty workout and add exercises as you go.
en: Start an empty workout and add exercises as you go.
nl: Start een lege training en voeg oefeningen toe terwijl je bezig bent.

key: E.g. “Monday: legs” – start it with one tap.
en: E.g. “Monday: legs” – start it with one tap.
nl: Bijv. “Maandag: benen” – start hem met één tik.

key: Copy the note from the Notes app and paste it here. A line with a date starts a new workout; lines without a date before them get the date below.
en: Copy the note from the Notes app and paste it here. A line with a date starts a new workout; lines without a date before them get the date below.
nl: Kopieer de notitie uit de Notities-app en plak hem hier. Een regel met een datum begint een nieuwe training; regels zonder datum ervoor krijgen de datum hieronder.

key: Liftr couldn't find any exercises. Use lines like “Leg press 3x12 40 kg”.
en: Liftr couldn't find any exercises. Use lines like “Leg press 3x12 40 kg”.
nl: Liftr vond geen oefeningen. Gebruik regels als “Leg press 3x12 40 kg”.

key: A routine is a fixed set of exercises, like “Monday: legs”. Start it with one tap and Liftr fills in what you did last time.
en: A routine is a fixed set of exercises, like “Monday: legs”. Start it with one tap and Liftr fills in what you did last time.
nl: Een schema is een vaste set oefeningen, zoals “Maandag: benen”. Start hem met één tik en Liftr vult in wat je vorige keer deed.

key: Log your exercises, sets, reps and weight in seconds — no more notes.
en: Log your exercises, sets, reps and weight in seconds — no more notes.
nl: Leg je oefeningen, sets, herhalingen en gewicht vast in een paar tikken. Geen notities meer.

key: Liftr shows what you did last time, your records and how much stronger you're getting.
en: Liftr shows what you did last time, your records and how much stronger you're getting.
nl: Liftr laat zien wat je vorige keer deed, je records en hoeveel sterker je wordt.

key: Workouts, calories and weight go to Apple Health. Train with your Apple Watch for heart rate too.
en: Workouts, calories and weight go to Apple Health. Train with your Apple Watch for heart rate too.
nl: Trainingen, calorieën en gewicht gaan naar Apple Gezondheid. Train met je Apple Watch voor ook je hartslag.

key: Liftr has no account, no server and no advertising. Your workouts, exercises, routines, body measurements and gym pass are stored on your device and in your own private iCloud.
en: Liftr has no account, no server and no advertising. Your workouts, exercises, routines, body measurements and gym pass are stored on your device and in your own private iCloud.
nl: Liftr heeft geen account, geen server en geen advertenties. Je trainingen, oefeningen, schema's, lichaamsmetingen en sportschoolpas staan op je apparaat en in je eigen privé-iCloud.

key: Only with your permission, Liftr reads your weight, body composition and resting heart rate, and saves workouts, calories, distance and weight. Health data never leaves your devices through Liftr and is never used for advertising. You can change access at any time in the Health app.
en: Only with your permission, Liftr reads your weight, body composition and resting heart rate, and saves workouts, calories, distance and weight. Health data never leaves your devices through Liftr and is never used for advertising. You can change access at any time in the Health app.
nl: Alleen met jouw toestemming leest Liftr je gewicht, lichaamssamenstelling en rusthartslag, en bewaart het trainingen, calorieën, afstand en gewicht. Gezondheidsgegevens verlaten je apparaten nooit via Liftr en worden nooit voor advertenties gebruikt. Je wijzigt de toegang altijd in de Gezondheid-app.

key: Syncing between your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch goes through your private iCloud database. The developer cannot see this data. The code of your gym pass is end-to-end encrypted.
en: Syncing between your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch goes through your private iCloud database. The developer cannot see this data. The code of your gym pass is end-to-end encrypted.
nl: Synchroniseren tussen je iPhone, iPad en Apple Watch gaat via je privé-iCloud-database. De ontwikkelaar kan deze gegevens niet zien. De code van je sportschoolpas is end-to-end versleuteld.

key: The camera and your photos are only used to read the code of your gym pass. Images are not saved or sent anywhere.
en: The camera and your photos are only used to read the code of your gym pass. Images are not saved or sent anywhere.
nl: De camera en je foto's worden alleen gebruikt om de code van je sportschoolpas te lezen. Afbeeldingen worden niet bewaard of verstuurd.

key: Reminders and the rest timer are planned on your device. There is no push server.
en: Reminders and the rest timer are planned on your device. There is no push server.
nl: Herinneringen en de rusttimer worden op je apparaat ingepland. Er is geen pushserver.

key: Liftr contains no analytics, no third-party code and no tracking of any kind.
en: Liftr contains no analytics, no third-party code and no tracking of any kind.
nl: Liftr bevat geen analytics, geen code van derden en geen enkele vorm van tracking.

key: Delete workouts in the app. To remove everything, delete Liftr and remove its data in Settings → your name → iCloud → Manage Storage.
en: Delete workouts in the app. To remove everything, delete Liftr and remove its data in Settings → your name → iCloud → Manage Storage.
nl: Verwijder trainingen in de app. Om alles te wissen verwijder je Liftr en haal je de gegevens weg via Instellingen → je naam → iCloud → Beheer opslag.

key: Liftr is built to keep your training private.
en: Liftr is built to keep your training private.
nl: Liftr is gemaakt om je training privé te houden.

key: Start rest timer after each set
en: Start rest timer after each set

key: Apple Health is not available on this device.
en: Apple Health is not available on this device.
nl: Apple Gezondheid is niet beschikbaar op dit apparaat.

key: Liftr saves workouts with duration and calories and reads your weight, body composition and resting heart rate. Change access in the Health app → Profile → Apps → Liftr.
en: Liftr saves workouts with duration and calories and reads your weight, body composition and resting heart rate. Change access in the Health app → Profile → Apps → Liftr.
nl: Liftr bewaart trainingen met duur en calorieën en leest je gewicht, lichaamssamenstelling en rusthartslag. Toegang wijzig je in de Gezondheid-app → Profiel → Apps → Liftr.

key: Your workouts sync through your own iCloud between iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
en: Your workouts sync through your own iCloud between iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
nl: Je trainingen synchroniseren via je eigen iCloud tussen iPhone, iPad en Apple Watch.

key: Allow notifications for Liftr in Settings to get reminders.
en: Allow notifications for Liftr in Settings to get reminders.
nl: Sta meldingen voor Liftr toe in Instellingen om herinneringen te krijgen.

key: When I haven't trained for a while
en: When I haven't trained for a while
nl: Als ik een tijd niet heb getraind

key: Reminders are planned on this device. A day you already trained (also on Apple Watch or iPad) is skipped.
en: Reminders are planned on this device. A day you already trained (also on Apple Watch or iPad) is skipped.
nl: Herinneringen worden op dit apparaat ingepland. Een dag waarop je al hebt getraind (ook op Apple Watch of iPad) wordt overgeslagen.

key: Charts are for strength exercises. Cardio sessions are in your history.
en: Charts are for strength exercises. Cardio sessions are in your history.
nl: Grafieken zijn er voor krachtoefeningen. Cardio staat in je geschiedenis.

key: Finish a workout and your progress shows up here.
en: Finish a workout and your progress shows up here.
nl: Rond een training af en je vooruitgang verschijnt hier.

key: No weight yet. Log it here or connect a smart scale to Apple Health.
en: No weight yet. Log it here or connect a smart scale to Apple Health.
nl: Nog geen gewicht. Voer het hier in of koppel een slimme weegschaal aan Apple Gezondheid.

key: Also removed from Apple Health if Liftr saved it there.
en: Also removed from Apple Health if Liftr saved it there.
nl: Wordt ook uit Apple Gezondheid gehaald als Liftr hem daar heeft opgeslagen.

key: Sets you didn't fill in are left out.
en: Sets you didn't fill in are left out.
nl: Sets die je niet hebt ingevuld worden weggelaten.

key: First time — set your starting point
en: First time — set your starting point

key: Start a workout from your watch face.
en: Start a workout from your watch face.
nl: Start een training vanaf je wijzerplaat.

key: Your training days, streak and last workout.
en: Your training days, streak and last workout.
nl: Je trainingsdagen, reeks en laatste training.
